paper.title: X-HD: Fast Hausdorff Distance Computation with Ray Tracing

public_or_existing_apis_exercised: nearest witness and grouped nearest witness study routes

reproduction_scope.input_policy: tiny same-input WKT fixture first; exact paper inputs are not pinned
reproduction_scope.output_policy: compare author HDResult against the directed input1-to-input2 Hausdorff value, plus bounded 2D/3D RTDL public column route output with explicit tolerance; symmetric Hausdorff max is diagnostic only; phase/performance fields are separate evidence

source_audit: src/flags.cc documents input, algorithm, execution, parameter, and JSON flags
expr/logs contains author JSON summaries but not the input datasets themselves

Goal5138 adds app-neutral RTDL NumPy reference APIs for point-grid tight cell-MBR descriptors and radius cell-MBR candidate rows. This is a system API contract step, not a native/OptiX backend or X-HD performance claim.

Goal5139 adds an app-neutral RTDL NumPy reference API for splitting cell candidates by current nearest state into inline, offload, and pruned frontiers. This is a system API contract step, not a native/OptiX backend or X-HD performance claim.
Goal5140 specifies the app-neutral native/RT ABI row schema for generic cell-MBR nearest frontiers and adds a row-table adapter. No native/OptiX backend or X-HD performance claim is made.

Goal5141 audits existing generic AABB/OptiX/fixed-radius/nearest-witness native assets and concludes that an OptiX backend spike is feasible but requires a new app-neutral native symbol. No backend or X-HD performance claim is made.

Goal5142 adds a generic executable 2-D backend-assisted front door that converts AABB membership rows into Goal5140 cell-MBR frontier row tables. It is not a complete native backend and makes no X-HD performance claim.

Goal5144 ran the backend-assisted 2-D cell-MBR front door on a CUDA/OptiX POD after building the current librtdl_optix.so. Goal5145 adds a public dimension-generic NumPy reference front door that composes cell-MBR candidate rows, nearest-state frontier splitting, and the Goal5140 row-table adapter. It validates a 3-D synthetic fixture and provides an oracle for future native 3-D backends. It does not implement a native backend or X-HD performance route.

Goal5146 adds and validates an app-neutral native OptiX 3-D AABB point-membership row producer: rtdl_optix_collect_prepared_aabb_index_3d_point_contains_rows. This is the first native 3-D AABB broadphase brick for the cell-MBR track, not a complete Goal5140 cell-MBR nearest-frontier backend or X-HD performance route.
Goal5147 local CPU gate: the public 3-D AABB-membership-assisted cell-MBR front door matched the Goal5145 dimension-generic oracle. This validates the generic route shape without native acceleration.

Goal5148 adds and validates a bounded app-neutral native OptiX 3-D cell-MBR nearest-frontier row producer: rtdl_optix_collect_cell_mbr_nearest_frontier_3d. Goal5158 same-POD production-style matrix after vectorizing the generic nearest-cell-MBR seed helper.
